fatal_failures: the exact public static GenerateInvoice(List<Loan>, List<? extends LoanEvent>, BillingPeriod) entry point or required public support types are absent
a full-return settlement date accrues, the CDM open date does not accrue, or a partial return is applied from instruction date instead of settlement date
a same-day mark is used for that day's fee accrual instead of a strictly earlier T-1 mark
a negative rebate spread is clamped, absolutized, or loses its sign during counterparty netting
the implementation passes monetary or rate arithmetic through double or float, edits generated model code, or nets different currencies together

criteria.description: Expose the exact billing contract with typed loans, events, records, and summaries.
checks: Compile and invoke benchmark.billing.MonthEndBilling.GenerateInvoice directly.
Return one typed LoanBillingRecord per loan and deterministic typed CounterpartySummary values.

criteria.description: Use prior marks and the correct open-inclusive, return-exclusive interval.
checks: The January GBP baseline emits GBP 5900.00 for exactly 30 accrual days.
The interval starts on 1 January and ends exclusively on 31 January.
The 1 January mark first applies on 2 January; no same-day or return-day amount leaks in.

criteria.description: Segment fee accrual at the start-of-day re-rate and settlement-effective partial return.
checks: The 1-11, 12-19, and 20-31 slices total GBP 3900.00.
The new fee applies on 12 January.
The quantity remains 100000 through 19 January and falls to 50000 on 20 January, regardless of the 15 January instruction date.

criteria.description: Preserve a negative rebate spread through the loan record and signed counterparty netting.
checks: Calculate cash collateral times benchmark minus rebate without a zero floor.
Emit a negative CDM Money record when rebate exceeds benchmark.
Net the signed record against a positive fee record for the same pair and currency without absolute values or clamping.

criteria.description: Apply ACT/360 and ACT/365 per loan and keep currencies separate.
checks: A USD ACT/360 loan and GBP ACT/365 loan each use their own basis.
The invoice emits separate USD and GBP summaries even for the same counterparty pair.
All record and summary Money values retain a non-blank matching currency.

criteria.description: Read the pinned CDM 7 security-loan topology and select economics from collateral style.
checks: Read direct effective and termination dates and the top-level SecurityLending AssetPayout from TradeState.trade.product.economicTerms.
Read a positive SHARE resolved quantity from that payout rather than a similarly shaped unrelated quantity.
Require NON_CASH plus FeeTerms or CASH plus RebateTerms and reject CASH_POOL, mismatches, missing paths, and extra/misclassified payouts.

criteria.description: Process unordered, loan-scoped events deterministically at their stated economic dates.
checks: Event-list order does not change records or summaries.
Relevant rate changes and settled returns before the billing-period start establish the opening state.
Reject unknown loans, null events, duplicate same-date marks/rates, style-inapplicable events, malformed dates, and excess returns.

criteria.description: Use exact signed decimal arithmetic and round once at the loan boundary.
checks: Divide daily accruals to scale 18 HALF_EVEN and retain them unrounded until the final loan record.
Round each record once to two decimals HALF_EVEN, then make each summary exactly reconcile to emitted records.
Never pass values through double or float; negative and high-scale values retain the expected sign and cents.

criteria.description: Validate inputs, keep outputs deterministic, and preserve caller-owned state.
checks: Reject blank/duplicate loan IDs, invalid periods, non-overlapping loans, malformed Money, negative rates, and unsupported day counts.
Preserve input order for records and sort summaries by lender, borrower, and currency.
Return unmodifiable defensive copies of result lists and do not mutate CDM inputs, loans, or events.
